notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Bellowing Aegisaur indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Bellowing Aegisaur.
description:
Give Bellowing Aegisaur indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Bellowing Aegisaur, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Bellowing Aegisaur, Ghyrson Starn, and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Bellowing Aegisaur, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Spark Double and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger.
Resolve the Bellowing Aegisaur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to Bellowing Aegisaur, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Ghyrson Starn and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
